description: Periodic per-currency aggregate pool report Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 L2 — emitted hourly (R1) / per-15-min (R2) / per-5-min (R3) by Pregel cell `kawase_pool_match` as a transparency artifact. Aggregate-only: NO per-member amounts, NO per-tx breakdowns. Toritate.annualReport consumes the sum-aggregate across epochs for the religious-corp annual transparency disclosure.

balanceMinor.description: Total pool balance held in KawaseYuiPool<currency> at epoch close (minor units).

inFlightMinor.description: Sum of deposits with intents still unmatched at epoch close (minor units).

reserveBufferFloorMinor.description: Minimum reserve buffer required per current sizing rule. R1 = $5_000 per pool; R2 = $50_000; R3 = $500_000 aggregate. If balanceMinor falls below this floor, new deposits halt for the pair until rebalance restores.

driftBps.description: Cumulative drift between paired pools in basis points (signed; positive = this pool is in surplus relative to its mid-market peg). When |driftBps| > 500, kawase_rebalance_proposer emits a rebalanceAttestation candidate for Council ≥4/7 sign-off.

mKotoConsumedThisEpoch.description: mKOTO debited from operator DID this epoch for pool_match cell ticks (sum across all matches).
